theme: telescope nights booked before knowing the sky's story
title: Beacon Nights: Booking a Schedule That Splits the Worst Story
strategies: trivial: reproduce the checker's own baseline -- book the first B nights in order, always using each night's first-listed (common) pointing
quality-greedy: sort ALL pointings by raw weight and take the highest-weight ones on distinct nights, ignoring which narrative pairs they split

worst-family marginal greedy: at each booking step, find the family with the lowest current pair-separation fraction and book whichever available pointing splits the most of THAT family's still-tied pairs, falling back to total-gain only when nothing helps the worst family

(headroom above strong): jointly optimize across steps instead of greedily -- e.g. exchange/local-search over the whole B-night schedule, or exact ILP for small K,M_f, since the greedy worst-family scan is not provably optimal itself
